stories.headline: UBTech Offers Up to $18M to Recruit Chief Scientist for Humanoid Robot AI Roadmap

key_facts.fact: UBTech is offering annual pay of up to 124 million yuan (~$18M), with a floor of 15 million yuan (~$2.18M), structured as a mix of cash, benefits, and equity.
key_facts.excerpt: UBTech is offering approximately $18 million (124 million RMB) for a single Chief Scientist position—an exceptionally high salary typically reserved for CEO-level executives.

key_facts.fact: The chief scientist will architect UBTech's embodied intelligence roadmap, focusing on vision-language-action models, manipulation learning, and transitioning lab research to real-world applications.
key_facts.excerpt: The Chief Scientist will architect UBTech's embodied intelligence roadmap, focusing on vision-language-action models, manipulation learning, and transitioning laboratory research into real-world applications across smart manufacturing, commercial services, and home environments.

key_facts.fact: UBTech's 2025 revenue reached 2.01 billion RMB, a 53.3% year-over-year increase, with humanoid products and services now comprising 41% of total revenue—a twentyfold increase.
key_facts.excerpt: 2025 revenue: 2.01 billion RMB, representing a 53.3% year-over-year increase. Humanoid products and services now comprise 41% of total revenue—a twentyfold increase.

key_facts.fact: Airbus purchased UBTech's Walker S2 humanoids for aircraft manufacturing in January 2026, validating real-world industrial deployment.
key_facts.excerpt: Airbus purchased Walker S2 humanoids for aircraft manufacturing in January 2026.

key_facts.fact: The salary is unprecedented in China's AI industry, which has historically eschewed the mega pay packages offered by firms like Meta. Competitors like Geekplus-W hired Tsinghua's Dr. Zhao Hao as chief scientist in February.
key_facts.excerpt: China's AI industry has eschewed mega pay packages that the likes of Meta Platforms Inc. have put together for elite scientists and engineers.

stories.headline: Meta's Ohio Data Center Seeks $3B in First-of-Its-Kind Loan Bundling Building and Power Assets

key_facts.fact: Meta's 'Project Walleye' Ohio data center is seeking $3 billion in loans in a first-of-its-kind financing structure where lenders fund both the building and the power assets in a single deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta's 'Project Walleye' Ohio data center seeks $3B in loans in a first-of-its-kind deal where lenders will fund both the building and the power assets.

key_facts.fact: The deal is innovative because data center financing traditionally separates building costs and energy/power system costs into separate lending arrangements.
key_facts.excerpt: A first-of-its-kind deal where lenders will fund both the building and the power assets.

key_facts.fact: Meta has separately tapped Pimco and Blue Owl for $29 billion in broader data center financing, and recently revised its El Paso data center investment to $10 billion for 1 GW capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta taps Pimco and Blue Owl for $29bn data center financing.

stories.headline: Iranian Strikes Render Two AWS Zones 'Hard Down' in Bahrain and Dubai; Amazon Tells Staff to Deprioritize

key_facts.fact: An internal Amazon memo states that one availability zone each in Dubai and Bahrain is 'hard down' while another in each location is 'impaired but functioning.'
key_facts.excerpt: One zone in each location is 'hard down' while another is 'impaired but functioning.'

key_facts.fact: The memo directed that 'services should not expect to be operating with normal levels of redundancy' and should be 'scaled to the minimal footprint required to support customer migration.'
key_facts.excerpt: Services should not expect to be operating with normal levels of redundancy. Services should be scaled to the minimal footprint required to support customer migration.

key_facts.fact: Amazon said it has no timeline for when the Dubai and Bahrain regions will return to normal operations, and is actively helping customers migrate workloads to alternate AWS regions.
key_facts.excerpt: We do not have a timeline for when DXB and BAH will return to normal operations.

key_facts.fact: A Wednesday strike caused a fire at Amazon's Bahrain facilities, with multiple hits sustained in the UAE, as the conflict nears its sixth week.
key_facts.excerpt: A Wednesday strike caused a fire at Amazon's Bahrain facilities, with multiple hits also sustained in the UAE.

key_facts.fact: The IRGC has threatened Microsoft, Google, and Apple infrastructure as economic targets in the Gulf region, naming 18 US tech companies as 'legitimate targets.'
key_facts.excerpt: The Guard warned that 18 tech companies would be considered as 'legitimate targets' in retaliation for U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran.

stories.headline: Global Semiconductor Sales Hit $88.8B in February, Up 61.8% YoY, on Track for $1 Trillion in 2026

key_facts.fact: Global semiconductor sales reached $88.8 billion in February 2026, up 7.6% from January's $82.5 billion and 61.8% higher than February 2025's $54.9 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Global semiconductor sales were $88.8 billion during February 2026, an increase of 7.6% compared to January 2026's $82.5 billion and 61.8% more than February 2025's $54.9 billion.

key_facts.fact: Regional year-over-year sales: Asia Pacific +93.5%, Americas +59.2%, China +57.4%, Europe +42.3%, Japan -0.3%.
key_facts.excerpt: Year-to-year sales in February were up in Asia Pacific/All Other (93.5%), the Americas (59.2%), China (57.4%), and Europe (42.3%), but declined in Japan (-0.3%).

key_facts.fact: SIA President John Neuffer said strong global demand is expected to persist, with annual sales projected to reach roughly $1 trillion globally in 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Global chip sales remained very strong in February, exceeding January's totals and far outpacing sales from February of last year.

key_facts.fact: The semiconductor industry on track to hit $1 trillion in sales in 2026, following a $791.7 billion haul in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Semiconductor industry on track to hit $1 trillion in sales in 2026, following $791.7 billion in 2025.

stories.headline: Chinese Chipmakers Report Record 2025 Revenues as Domestic AI Chip Share Hits 41% of Market

key_facts.fact: China's largest chipmaker SMIC reported 2025 revenue rose 16% YoY to a record $9.3 billion; analysts expect it could top $11 billion in 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: SMIC reported revenue for 2025 rose 16% from a year ago to a record $9.3 billion. Revenue could top $11 billion in 2026.

key_facts.fact: Domestic vendors shipped 1.65 million AI accelerator cards in 2025, capturing 41% of the Chinese market and closing in on Nvidia's 55% share, according to IDC data.
key_facts.excerpt: Domestic vendors shipped 1.65 million accelerator cards in 2025, capturing 41 percent of the market and closing in on Nvidia's 55 percent share.

key_facts.fact: Huawei shipped 812,000 AI chips in 2025, emerging as the leading Chinese AI chip supplier amid US export controls.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei emerged as a significant player, shipping 812,000 chips in 2025 amid U.S. export controls.

key_facts.fact: CXMT's revenue jumped about 130% to ¥55 billion; Moore Threads guided 2025 revenue of ¥1.45-1.52 billion, a 231-247% YoY increase.
key_facts.excerpt: CXMT's revenue jumped about 130% to ¥55 billion. Moore Threads guided that 2025 revenue would be between 1.45 billion yuan and 1.52 billion yuan, a 231% to 247% year-on-year increase.

key_facts.fact: Record revenues were driven by AI demand, memory shortages, and US export restrictions that pushed Beijing to favor domestic suppliers.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese semiconductor firms reported record 2025 revenues driven by AI demand, memory shortages and U.S. export restrictions that pushed Beijing to favor domestic suppliers.

stories.headline: ULA Launches 29 Amazon Leo Satellites on Heaviest Atlas V Payload Ever From Cape Canaveral

key_facts.fact: The LA-05 mission launched at 1:46 a.m. ET on April 4, 2026 from Space Launch Complex-41 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station aboard a ULA Atlas V 551 rocket.
key_facts.excerpt: Liftoff of the LA-05 mission occurred at 1:46 a.m. ET on Saturday (April 4), 2026.

key_facts.fact: The mission deployed 29 Amazon Leo internet satellites, making it the heaviest payload ever launched by an Atlas V rocket.
key_facts.excerpt: Atlas V rocket launches its heaviest-ever payload, sending 29 Amazon internet satellites to orbit.

key_facts.fact: Joint engineering between Amazon and ULA enabled a new four-tier dispenser configuration and Centaur upper stage updates to increase from previous payloads to 29 satellites.
key_facts.excerpt: Joint engineering work between Amazon and ULA to take advantage of additional performance margin, with updates to the Centaur upper stage and a new four-tier dispenser configuration.

key_facts.fact: Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper) is building a constellation of 3,236 satellites to provide broadband internet access, with a mid-year FCC deadline to grow to ~1,600 satellites.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon Leo, formerly known as Project Kuiper, is a mega constellation of satellites in Low Earth Orbit that will offer broadband internet access, planned to be composed of 3,236 satellites.

stories.headline: Musk Requires Banks Seeking SpaceX IPO Roles to Buy Grok Subscriptions and Advertise on X

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk is requiring banks and law firms advising on SpaceX's IPO to purchase subscriptions to Grok, his AI chatbot, and advertise on X as a condition for IPO roles.
key_facts.excerpt: Mr. Musk is requiring Wall Street firms to purchase subscriptions to his A.I. chatbot if they want to advise on one of the largest initial public offerings in history.

key_facts.fact: Some banks have agreed to spend millions annually on Grok and have begun integrating it into their IT systems as a mandatory condition for SpaceX IPO roles.
key_facts.excerpt: Some banks have agreed to spend millions annually on Grok and have begun integrating it into their IT systems as a mandatory condition for SpaceX IPO roles.

key_facts.fact: Lead underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Citigroup, with international banks RBC, Mizuho, and Macquarie also participating.
key_facts.excerpt: The lead underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Citigroup. International participants: Royal Bank of Canada, Mizuho Financial Group, and Macquarie Group.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX's IPO targets a valuation above $2 trillion and aims to raise a record $75 billion, which would surpass Saudi Aramco and Alibaba as the largest listing in history.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX has set its target IPO valuation at over $2 trillion. Could become the largest stock market listing in history, surpassing Saudi Aramco (2019) and Alibaba (2014).
